title: Probe Annotary: request threads and source mapping
content:
Purpose and quick summary:
This is a working notebook (annotary) that stitches together a compact catalog of incoming customer requests over the last 9 months, annotated by origin, estimated impact, immediate micropatch ideas, and suggested probes. The goal: create short experiments (1–2 sprint) to validate high-leverage fixes and collect deterministic usage signals that feed Product and Eng planning. Not intended as final roadmap — think: triage + probe plan.

What I mean by origin mapping (why this matters):
- Support tickets: often high frequency, lower visibility into long-term impact; we need reproducible repro steps and sample inputs
- CSM conversations: high intent / revenue signal, more context but fewer data points
- Telemetry anomalies: automated signals (latency spikes, error rates) with weak user intent mapping
- Sales / pre-sales asks: early adoption signals (feature gaps blocking closed-won)
- SRE / infra alerts: operational asks that affect many customers but are non-feature

High-level counts (rough, from ad-hoc query + manual review):
- Total unique request threads sampled: 112 (Jan 2028 — Apr 2028)
- Support-origin: 48 threads (43%)
- CSM-origin: 21 threads (19%)
- Sales/pre-sales: 14 threads (12%)
- Telemetry / logs: 18 threads (16%)
- Internal (SRE/ops/prod): 11 threads (10%)

Top recurring themes (quant + qualitative):
1) Model fallback and semantics drift (31 threads) — customers seeing silent fallback to smaller quantized model variants without clear signals in responses; confidence/confusion when style/length changes.
   - Typical origin: telemetry + support tickets when customers hit throttling or capacity fallbacks.
   - Severity: medium-high (can break UX and reduce trust).
   - Microproposal: 1-week patch to add a per-response header and telemetry flag in SDK that explicitly includes "model_variant" + fallback_reason. Add a prompt-level trace id to correlate with logs.
   - Probe: 2-week trial with 3 pilot customers; collect before/after NPS for embedded flows.

2) Embeddings quality variance by region/hardware (24 threads) — same model yields different cosine similarity distributions across regions or dedicated nodes (likely quantization/seed/hardware differences).
   - Origin: CSM + telemetry + one bench test from Eng.
   - Severity: high for search/semantic-match use cases.
   - Microproposal: create a small auto-eval harness (dataset of ~200 query-doc pairs from 2 customers) and run nightly scoring across regions and dedicated pools. Surface regression alerts.
   - Probe: run for 3 weeks, blocklist repro buckets and notify customers proactively when variance exceeds threshold.

3) Rate-limiting surprises and token accounting confusion (17 threads) — customers expect token usage per conversation but see spikes during streaming or function-calling cases.
   - Origin: support + sales demos.
   - Severity: medium.
   - Microproposal: short doc + SDK change that returns per-chunk token estimate and a billing-sim mode for dev accounts.
   - Probe: ship doc + billing-sim flag to 10 trial accounts and collect confusion tags via in-app survey.

4) Rollouts and A/B defaulting mismatch (11 threads) — when a model rollout is canaried, some routes see a larger share of fallback than intended due to routing policy misalignment.
   - Origin: telemetry + product tickets.
   - Severity: medium.
   - Microproposal: expose rollout-percent by route in Console (read-only for CS) and surface an anomaly if percent deviates by >10% for >12 hours.

5) Private deployment onboarding friction (29 threads) — docs + network config + KMS onboarding are the biggest blockers.
   - Origin: pre-sales + CSM + solutions-eng.
   - Severity: high for enterprise deals.
   - Microproposal: create a one-page "VPC onboarding checklist" with expected timeline and common CIDR gotchas; pair with a new boxed "onboarding sandbox" script for customers to run before we schedule our infra team.

Signal prioritization heuristic (proposal):
- Priority score = (Revenue signal weight * account_tier) + (User-impact weight * affected_users_estimate) + (Operational risk weight * outage_likelihood) + (Detection gap weight * telemetry_coverage_gap) - (Implementation effort estimate)
- Quick weights for next quarter: revenue 3x, user-impact 2x, op-risk 2x, detection gap 1.5x, effort penalty 1x.
- This yields a working backlog for microproposals. Not gospel — use as starting filter for sprint planning.

Annotated catalog (sample of 12 threads with action items):
- T-001: "silent fallback to quant-4h" (Support#4876; telemetry spike 2028-02-14) — action: implement per-response variant header. Owner: Eng-inference (Riley). Target: probe w/3 customers by 2028-06-01.
- T-002: "embeddings drift EU-west vs us-east" (CSM: Acme Corp) — action: nightly eval harness + alert. Owner: Applied-ML (Sofia). Target: prototype by 2028-05-30.
- T-003: "streaming tokens counted unexpectedly" (Support#4921) — action: SDK change + billing-sim mode. Owner: DevX (Ben). Target: doc + flag beta by 2028-05-25.
- T-004: "private deploy: failed KMS handshake" (Sales POC) — action: onboarding checklist + sandbox script. Owner: Solutions Eng (Priya K.). Target: 2-week deliverable.
- T-005: "console rollout % mismatch" (Product) — action: expose routing metrics to CS read-only. Owner: Console team. Target: design review mid-June.
- T-006: "batching latency spikes for short prompts" (SRE) — action: new batching policy lint + experiment to reduce batch hold-time for <64 token requests. Owner: Serving Runtime (Jae).
- T-007: "embedding quality regressions after quant patch" (Telemetry+CSM) — action: rollback candidate + bisect plan. Owner: Applied-ML.
- T-008: "unexpected 429s during demo" (Sales) — action: temp quota bypass for demo accounts + new staging route. Owner: Eng-Infra.
- T-009: "reliability of prefix cache for long-context sessions" (Customer: Noteflow) — action: add per-session cache diagnostics and a toggle for cache persistence. Owner: Serving Runtime.
- T-010: "lack of traceability for function calling failures" (Support) — action: structured error map + doc + enhanced logging. Owner: DevX.
- T-011: "embedding index mismatches when using dedicated pools" (CS) — action: run reconciler and snapshot tool; surface delta report in CS UI.
- T-012: "billing confusion in aggregated invoices" (Finance+Customer) — action: quick-bake: example invoice walkthrough doc and FAQ; mid-term: exportable detailed usage CSV.

Unresolved puzzles / open questions (notes-to-self):
- How many of the reported "embeddings variance" cases are caused by seed/quant differences versus data preprocess differences? Need a small deterministic dataset and reproducible containerized runbook.
- Can we cheaply add a "model_variant" header without inflating per-response payload across streaming? Engineering estimate needed.
- For private deployments, what are the top 3 network patterns customers fail at? (need Solutions Eng survey).
- Is billing-sim flag safe w.r.t. quotas? risk of customers misusing to test high-volume flows.

Quick experiments proposed (1–2 week scope each):
- E1: model_variant header + small SDK telemetry (instrumentation only, no UI). Goal: reduce "why did my style change" support threads by 50% in pilots.
- E2: nightly embedding eval across 4 regions using a seeded 200-pair dataset. Goal: detect >2% cosine shift and auto-notify CS.
- E3: billing-sim flag (dev-only) + 3 sample invoices for customers to review. Goal: reduce token-accounting support threads.
- E4: VPC onboarding sandbox script + checklist; run with 2 upcoming POCs. Goal: reduce onboarding time by 30%.

Stakeholder asks and immediate next steps: (this is actionable list for next week)
- Riley: estimate effort and feasibility for E1 (due 2028-05-21).
- Sofia: prototype embedding eval harness and run across prod/dedicated for 3 days (due 2028-05-24).
- Ben: draft SDK + doc changes for billing-sim and per-chunk token estimate (due 2028-05-23).
- CS leadership: confirm pilot customers for E1 and E3 (Arjun to ping list).

Metrics to watch (if we run probes):
- Reduction in "why did model change" CSM tickets within pilot accounts
- Embedding similarity variance percentiles by region (P50/P90)
- Number of token-accounting confusion tickets after billing-sim pilot
- Average onboarding time (days) for private deployments

Risks and mitigations: 
- Risk: pilots surface more regressions (e.g., harness shows problems we can't quickly fix). Mitigation: limit to 3 pilots and have rollback plan + dedicated incident channel.
- Risk: billing-sim might be mis-adopted. Mitigation: dev-only flag behind account-level setting; telemetry to watch for misuse.
- Risk: telemetry/alert noise. Mitigation: tune thresholds and use aggregated insights rather than per-event pings initially.

Appendix: quick links and reproducible notes (scratch):
- Query used to sample support tickets: "label:customer-issue AND tag:embedding OR tag:billing" (exported to CS-REQ-INDEX-2028).
- Minimal embedding eval dataset: internal csv path: gs://redwood-signal/emb-eval/seed-200-v1.csv (ask Sofia for access).
- Slack notes: #cs-field-vox-thread-042 contains raw snippets of customer quotes (use for quoting in external comms).

Closing (notes to product and eng partners):
This is intentionally lightweight and somewhat messy — it's a probe notebook not a final deliverable. The value is in tight, measurable experiments that convert noisy customer friction into actionable telemetry and small engineering patches. If we run E1–E3 concurrently, we should have 4–6 weeks of signal to decide which items graduate to scoped roadmap work.

Draft history: Arjun initial capture 2028-05-10; Riley + Sofia + Ben notes + inline edits 2028-05-14 — 2028-05-18.

Open: mark as draft until probes scoped and owners confirm.
